added: Overlap between derivatives and outputs is the norm in physical and control models (§5.3).
The section gives the four steps, then the prior art, then an idiom the design admits without framework support.
The section states the invariant's scope, the policy's three tiers, what the log does not record, and the tools for garbage that cannot be avoided.
The zero-allocation invariant is scoped to the stepping loop, and the stopped-sim services were always allocation-tolerant (D-135, §14.8).
Publication is not a phase body (D-288, §9.7), and its one snapshot allocation per boundary sits with logging on the framework side, outside what the invariant claims is zero (§11.2).
